==Hero Usage==
* Heroes will maintain this spell both in and out of combat. They will drop the ashes once three or more party members need healing.

== Notes ==
* Precast this item spell to gain reduced damage provided by the additional armor rating and drop the ashes to use as an emergency [[Heal Party]] or when energy is low to regain the benefits from your [[weapon set]].
* Can be maintained indefinitely by re-casting the spell while still holding the ashes to retain the additional armor rating while providing a steady stream of [[party healing]].
* Requires care when facing [[Soul Bind]] or [[Scourge Healing]] as once the item spell has been cast, the party heal cannot be stopped.
* Combines well with [[Herald's Insignia]] for an extra +10 armor rating.
